items.title: Pay settling-in package invoice
items.quote: Please pay within 30 days of the date of this letter by bank transfer to the account shown below, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Sender is a private company, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the letter's own date, 11 February 2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (11 Feb) is not counted, so counting starts 12 Feb 2026. 30 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on Friday, 13 March 2026. That day is a business day (no weekend or NW public holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 13 March 2026.
